common.style_usage: the exact Stardew Valley style of this framed wall painting: square-on, a frame around a small painted picture, one tile is 16 pixels, dark coloured (not black) outlines

living_painting.description: Stardew Valley wall decoration, a framed old oil painting hung flat on a wall, square-on, alone on a transparent background, one tile is 16 pixels, an ornate old gilt frame, dark coloured (not black) outlines: an old painting of a river at dusk, a little stone mill on the far bank with one warmly lit window, the river wide across the lower half with pale light glinting on the water, a willow on the near bank, a deep blue evening sky
